who_for: A standing desk lets you switch between sitting and standing through the day. That's a good fit if you work at a desk for hours and want more movement. Standing all day isn't the goal. Alternating is.
Check the height range against your own height, and make sure the desktop is big enough for your monitors and keyboard.

how_we_picked.label: Stability
how_we_picked.text: Wobble at standing height is the most common complaint, so we favored frames that owners and reviewers describe as steady.

how_we_picked.label: Height range
how_we_picked.text: We checked that each desk goes low and high enough for a wide range of people, including tall users.

how_we_picked.label: Motors and lift capacity
how_we_picked.text: Dual motors lift more weight more smoothly and usually last longer than single-motor frames.

how_we_picked.label: Desktop size and quality
how_we_picked.text: We compared desktop sizes and materials, from laminate to bamboo and solid wood.

how_we_picked.label: Warranty
how_we_picked.text: Strong frame and motor warranties, often five years or more, signal a desk built to last.
